layout_plan.composition: Persistent left sidebar/rail navigation + a main content panel — an app shell, NOT a centered marketing column.
Main-panel hero: headline + primary action beside a dashboard/product preview card.
Bento-style tiles inside the content panel (unequal sizes).
Inline CTA card pinned within the content panel.

notes:
TYPOGRAPHY (from the pinterest design system — use these EXACT family stacks as the CSS font-family; apply via inline style fontFamily or a Tailwind arbitrary value): display "Pin Sans" for headings/hero, body "Pin Sans" for body/labels. These are proprietary/system fonts — do NOT add a Google Fonts <link>; the system fallback baked into the stack is intentional and correct. Never substitute a serif.

Design DNA: Modern, bold, airy layout with lots of negative space. Bold red #E60023 as accent for main CTAs, white backgrounds, subtle neutral grays for neutral elements, readable sans-serif font, pill-shaped buttons, minimal glass for overlays. Smooth motion everywhere. Fully dark-mode capable.. Animation: Framer Motion fade/pop for all modals, buttons, skeletons. Interaction: Hover lifts, button active scales, scroll-to-top animates, infinite scroll fetch.. Color scheme: light.

LAYOUT ARCHETYPE: sidebar-app — build each page from its layout_plan; do NOT collapse into a centered hero followed by a uniform 3-card grid and footer. A card grid, if used, is at most ONE section among differently-composed sections.

REFERENCE DESIGN SYSTEM: pinterest — this is THIS project's design system. USE its palette (tokens.colors above are taken from it) and its font stacks. DISTILL its component treatments (buttons, cards, nav), type scale + tracking, spacing rhythm, and depth/shadow system, and match its level of polish. Do NOT fall back to generic defaults (raw Tailwind gray text, #3B82F6 blue, system fonts) or invent an unrelated purple/dark theme. Brief follows:

---
version: alpha
name: Pinterest-design-analysis
description: |
  A photography-first discovery system organized around the Pinterest Red CTA, the masonry pin grid, and a soft warm-cream chrome that gets out of the imagery's way. The home page is a content-discovery tool wearing the chrome of a magazine publisher: 70px display headlines, friendly Pin Sans typography, fully-rounded pill buttons (16px) on a cream-tinted neutral palette, and a sticky red "Sign up" CTA that anchors every viewport. Pin imagery is the system's load-bearing visual element — square, portrait, and landscape pins tile in a column-based masonry grid where each tile is a fully-rounded 16px-radius card, separated by tight 8px gutters. The chrome is otherwise quiet: warm grays, true whites, and a single saturated red — no decorative gradients, no atmospheric backgrounds, no shadows beyond a soft modal scrim.
